bootstrap.why: The M0 checker and schema are descendants of the selected review tree and have no independent bootstrap or execution-custody binding.

blockers: The seed and static grammars are bounded and do not prove that every runtime launch is represented.
No launch edge has execution custody, resolved environment, or a closed import/dynamic-source chain at M0.
closure_claims.meaning: Static candidates whose resolved source path has a check-* verifier spelling.

blockers: The seed and static grammars are bounded and do not prove that every runtime launch is represented.
No launch edge has execution custody, resolved environment, or a closed import/dynamic-source chain at M0.
closure_claims.meaning: All candidate Python launches found by the bounded M0 seed and grammars.

environment_profiles.scope: cwd, variables, sys.path, site state, file descriptors, signals, and platform are unresolved.

external_tool_profiles.scope: Command wrappers, module tools, shells, and external executable identities are unresolved.
Exact selected-tree blob retrieval; Git executable identity is not authenticated.
Selected AST child-process call spellings; runtime behavior is not resolved.

interpreter_profiles.scope: Textual python/python3/pypy/$PYTHON command token without executable identity.
Selected sys.executable or static Python token in a Python child-process AST call.
AST parser requirement only; it is not interpreter authenticity or target-runtime identity.

seed_policy.python_sources: every tracked *.py path in the selected review tree
unscanned_examples: Rust/native sources outside the declared operational-root seed
untracked, ignored, generated-at-runtime, external, or absent-history sources
